title: Ashmita Chaliha Stuns Han to Clinch Maiden BWF Korea Masters Title
indian_angle: Indian shuttler Ashmita Chaliha secured her first BWF Tour title, marking a significant victory for India in international badminton.
summary: The 26-year-old from Assam overcame a slow start to defeat world No. 35 Han 14-21, 21-14, 21-14 in a memorable summit clash at the Korea Masters.

title: Ashmita Chaliha Enters Elite Club of Indian Women's Singles Champions
indian_angle: Ashmita Chaliha's Korea Masters win makes her only the fifth Indian woman to claim a Super 300 or higher title, alongside legends like Saina Nehwal and PV Sindhu.
summary: Her breakthrough victory at the Korea Masters places Ashmita Chaliha in an exclusive group of Indian women, including Saina Nehwal, PV Sindhu, Devika Sihag, and Tanvi Sharma, who have won a BWF Super 300 or higher title.

title: Who Follows Satwik-Chirag? India's Badminton Doubles Pipeline Under Scrutiny
indian_angle: Chief national coach Gopichand addresses the crucial need to develop the next generation of Indian men's doubles players to sustain the success seen with Satwikairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty.
summary: With the success of Satwikairaj Rankireddy and Chirag Shetty, questions arise about the depth of India's badminton doubles talent, prompting chief national coach Gopichand to advocate for a structured system to nurture future stars from the grassroots.
